title: Ropedia Xperience-10M Glossary
purpose: Define reader-facing terms that can be confused across the repo, website, Hugging Face mirrors, result matrices, and model-package surfaces.

categories.label: Dataset and scope
categories.description: Public data boundaries, evidence lines, and what each result can claim.

categories.label: Files and features
categories.description: How raw sample files, windows, feature manifests, and public-safe derivatives relate.

categories.label: Tasks and metrics
categories.description: Task contracts, scored records, direct scores, compact proxies, and audits.

categories.label: Models and runs
categories.description: Baseline families, Qwen3-Omni, Cosmos3, LoRA adapters, and full-parameter gates.

categories.label: Public surfaces
categories.description: GitHub, website, Hugging Face repos, parity checks, and package validation.

entries.plain_meaning: The upstream embodied human-interaction dataset.
entries.project_usage: Source dataset behind the public sample, selected-128 features, task suite, and model diagnostics.
entries.do_not_confuse_with: This repo, which only redistributes public-safe derived artifacts.

entries.plain_meaning: One officially available sample episode.
entries.project_usage: The fully inspectable Line 1 unit used for raw-file browsing, 20-frame windows, task construction, and single-episode baselines.

entries.plain_meaning: A public-safe selected subset of official gated episode paths.
entries.project_usage: Line 2 uses derived windows/features and keeps links back to official episode ids and gated source paths.

entries.plain_meaning: A claim boundary for a group of results.
entries.project_usage: Line 1 is one public sample episode; Line 2 is selected-128 held-out comparison.
entries.do_not_confuse_with: Qwen run versions v1-v6, which are model-run lineage.

entries.plain_meaning: Upstream files that require official dataset access.
entries.project_usage: Raw Xperience-10M MP4/HDF5/RRD files and full source directories remain outside the public repo.
entries.do_not_confuse_with: Public-safe metrics, derived features, figures, and manifests.

entries.plain_meaning: A file that can be mirrored publicly without raw gated content.
entries.project_usage: Metrics, JSON summaries, model cards, figures, derived manifests, and approved lightweight weights/adapters.

entries.plain_meaning: One recorded interaction sequence.
entries.project_usage: The basic source unit behind windows, labels, and train/val/test splits.

entries.plain_meaning: A fixed short clip slice.
entries.project_usage: The sample episode is converted into aligned 20-frame units for features, labels, and many task heads.
entries.do_not_confuse_with: A full episode or arbitrary video segment.

entries.plain_meaning: A map from model-input columns to source modalities.
entries.project_usage: Explains feature groups and dimensions for the sample task suite.

entries.plain_meaning: Upstream annotation container for the sample.
entries.project_usage: Contains original labels/metadata; some public derived files expose processed features instead of every raw text field.

entries.plain_meaning: Natural-language interaction/caption content.
entries.project_usage: Used by task 15 and some derived text features; public matrices record direct or compact-proxy status.
entries.do_not_confuse_with: Numeric action ids or subtask ids.

entries.plain_meaning: A type of signal.
entries.project_usage: Video, audio, depth, pose/SLAM, motion capture, inertial, calibration, and language-derived signals.

entries.plain_meaning: The definition of one benchmark task.
entries.project_usage: Includes input, target/output, metric, split, source artifact, and limitation.

entries.plain_meaning: The current task surface.
entries.project_usage: All 20 task contracts are presented together and scored across methods where real artifacts exist.
entries.do_not_confuse_with: Historical tier2_task_suite filenames, which are provenance paths rather than a second suite.

entries.plain_meaning: One method evaluated on one task.
entries.project_usage: 9 methods x 20 tasks gives 180 public result records.

entries.plain_meaning: A metric computed against the task target directly.
entries.project_usage: The preferred score type in the 20-task matrix.

entries.plain_meaning: A bounded proxy metric when a direct raw target is not publicly available.
entries.project_usage: Kept explicit in the matrix and gap audit so readers do not over-read it.

entries.plain_meaning: The original metric value emitted by the runner or verified result package.
entries.project_usage: This is the value to cite from the 180-result table.

entries.plain_meaning: A 0-1 plotting value used only to draw comparable radar polygons.
entries.project_usage: Helps visualize metrics with different scales and directions.
entries.do_not_confuse_with: The raw metric value to cite.

entries.plain_meaning: A coverage and source-status audit.
entries.project_usage: Explains scored, proxy, and unsupported cells.

entries.plain_meaning: A split or feature rule that prevents using target information unfairly.
entries.project_usage: Chronological splits, held-out splits, and source audits protect task interpretation.

entries.plain_meaning: A simple non-neural task head; the "minimum" reference row in casual wording.
entries.project_usage: Provides a reproducible lower-complexity comparison for task feasibility.

entries.plain_meaning: A non-neural baseline family for the selected-128 rows.
entries.project_usage: Used for metadata/text and raw-feature 128-episode comparisons before NN/foundation-model rows.

entries.plain_meaning: A compact neural task head.
entries.project_usage: Used for single-episode and selected-128 baseline comparisons.

entries.plain_meaning: The multimodal foundation-model family used for the Qwen branch.
entries.project_usage: The current public 20-task Qwen row is Qwen3-Omni v6 LoRA plus task-specific probes.

entries.plain_meaning: The Qwen3-Omni run lineage.
entries.project_usage: v1-v4 are earlier pipeline/ablation evidence, v5 is the prior pinned release, and v6 is the current public 20-task row.

entries.plain_meaning: The larger Cosmos3-style branch tracked in this project.
entries.project_usage: Published as Reasoner diagnostics and a separate forward-dynamics LoRA adapter/result branch when verified.

entries.plain_meaning: A smaller Cosmos3 compatibility/future-window branch.
entries.project_usage: Used for the Nano Future Window row and related diagnostics.

entries.plain_meaning: A lightweight set of trainable adapter weights.
entries.project_usage: Published only when the package is verified and public-safe.

entries.plain_meaning: Updating the whole model rather than only adapters.
entries.project_usage: This project records feasibility gates and short pilots, but does not publish full checkpoints.

entries.plain_meaning: A high-level training direction.
entries.project_usage: Spatial intelligence, human-video world modeling, and vision-language-action are documented as trainable directions with task mappings.

entries.plain_meaning: Learning geometry and spatial reasoning from egocentric data.
entries.project_usage: Uses video, depth, camera pose, and language tasks to target 3D/space reasoning.

entries.plain_meaning: Learning future frames, actions, and interaction dynamics from human video.
entries.project_usage: Uses temporal prediction, next-action, transition, and object-forecast tasks.

entries.plain_meaning: Mapping perception and language to action chunks.
entries.project_usage: A future policy/VLA direction that needs action-target conversion and stronger policy packaging.

entries.plain_meaning: Hugging Face-hosted app/site surface.
entries.project_usage: Mirrors the dashboard and static website assets.
entries.do_not_confuse_with: HF artifact dataset or model repo.

entries.plain_meaning: Hugging Face dataset repo for derived evidence.
entries.project_usage: Stores public-safe reports, metrics, website JSON, and sanitized result packages.

entries.plain_meaning: Hugging Face model repo for lightweight baseline artifacts.
entries.project_usage: Mirrors baseline weights, figures, metrics, and task artifacts.

entries.plain_meaning: A check that public copies match the source files.
entries.project_usage: Records whether GitHub, website, and HF mirrors agree.

entries.plain_meaning: A result or artifact bundle that passed local/public validators.
entries.project_usage: Only verified packages are promoted to README, website, and HF surfaces as public evidence.
